items.answer: Deliver two pure library functions that other parts of the Watchlist POC import: (1) a notch calculator that takes a previous and current rating and returns the signed notch change, the direction and the resulting WL (REQ-06-02), and (2) the Indicator 12 (country rating change) WL derived from the notch change (REQ-03-12). Success means the exact contract in JOB.md exists and gives the C1-C8 results, checked by `node --test`, e.g. BBB+ -> BB+ = {notches:3, direction:'downgrade', wl:2}, BBB+ -> BBB- = {notches:2, wl:1}, and Indicator 12 gives 1 notch -> 1 and 2+ notches -> 2.

items.answer: src/ratings/notch.mjs: RATING_SCALE = the 19 C1 ratings, best first. notchChange(previous, current) -> integer = index(current) - index(previous): positive = downgrade, negative = upgrade, 0 = unchanged; range -18..+18. notchCalculator(previous, current) -> { notches, direction, wl }: notches same signed value as notchChange (C5); direction 'downgrade'|'upgrade'|'unchanged'; wl 0 for upgrade/unchanged/1-notch downgrade, 1 for 2-notch downgrade, 2 for 3+ (C2, C3, C6). src/indicators/countryRating.mjs: countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current) -> 0|1|2: 0 for upgrade/unchanged, 1 for 1-notch downgrade, 2 for 2+ (built on notchChange). Arguments are rating strings, case-insensitive and trimmed. Null, undefined, '', non-strings, internal spaces and off-scale ratings are rejected. All synchronous.

items.question: C1 says the input is 'trimmed' but not which whitespace. Which characters are removed before a rating is matched?
options: A: JavaScript String.prototype.trim(): all Unicode whitespace and line terminators at both ends (space, tab, CR/LF, NBSP, BOM …).
B: ASCII whitespace only (space, tab, CR, LF, VT, FF); NBSP or other Unicode spaces give a RangeError.
C: Plain space only; tabs, newlines and NBSP give a RangeError.
items.impact: Changes observable behaviour for inputs such as '\tBBB+\n' or '\u00A0BBB+'. QA cannot write the trimming criterion until answered. Internal whitespace ('BBB +') is rejected under every option.
